value.value: Separate as-synthesized powders from supernatant by centrifugation until the solution appears colorless. Wash the retained powders three times with demineralized water and once with 96% ethanol, then dry in a Thermo Scientific Heraeus vacuum oven. Centrifuge settings, solvent quantities, vacuum pressure and yields are absent. Apply this workup separately to the microwave, SCF and autoclave powders; these are alternative specimens, never a pooled charge. This workup is not automatically assigned to D-series solutions or in situ capillary observations.
